title: Hyperscale Deal Sends This Hospitality Stock To A 44% Weekly Gain

title: Is Salesforce (CRM) Now Offering Value After A 26% One Year Share Price Fall?
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 在股价一年下跌 26% 后现在还能提供价值吗？
summary: If you are wondering whether Salesforce at around US$187 represents value or risk at this point, this article will help you view the stock through a clear valuation lens.
summary_zh: 如果您想知道此时 187 美元左右的 Salesforce 代表价值还是风险，本文将帮助您通过清晰的估值视角来看待该股票。

title: BlackRock Is Paying $350,000 for Crypto Executives: Is Wall Street Digital Asset Takeover Just Getting Started?
title_zh: 贝莱德斥资 35 万美元聘请加密货币高管：华尔街数字资产收购才刚刚开始吗？
summary: Leading Wall Street firms BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Citigroup are actively posting crypto jobs, not for experimental blockchain labs, but for permanent digital asset desks running live revenue operations.
summary_zh: 华尔街领先的公司贝莱德、高盛、摩根士丹利和花旗集团正在积极发布加密货币职位，不是针对实验性区块链实验室，而是针对运行实时收入业务的永久数字资产部门。

title: State dealer laws add up to $5K to a new vehicle’s price, think tank finds
title_zh: 智囊团发现，州经销商法使新车价格增加了 5,000 美元
summary: “Protecting an incumbent distribution channel is not the same as protecting consumers,” the International Center for Law & Economics concluded in an issue brief.
summary_zh: “保护现有分销渠道与保护消费者不同，”国际法律与经济中心在一份问题简报中总结道。
